decision.label: ANSWER
decision.response: Yes, splitting your 150 kg/ha of urea into three applications is the correct approach for your farm this season, provided you have good rainfall. The manual states that while the standard practice is two applications (half at planting, half 30-45 days later), in cases of good rain, urea can be applied in three phases: 1/3 at planting, 1/3 after 30 days, and the remaining 1/3 three weeks after the second application.
decision.justification: Page 12 (garlic:p012:e0003) explicitly details the fertilizer application schedule. It confirms the standard rate of 150 kg/ha Urea split into two applications but adds the specific condition: 'In some cases, when there is good rain, application of urea can be done in three phases (1/3 during planting, 1/3 after 30 days planting and the remaining three weeks after the second application).'
